translation:
The accumulation of more than sixty years of low back pain was undoubtedly large, and it was hard to get it to rise separately; how strange! I rubbed until midnight, the whole body sweated, and the pain also stopped. There were also sinews in the hands and feet that were drawn and moved; one can know how deep the root of the disease was, and it is no wonder the accumulation grew. Using the thumb to push the jaw back thousands and ten-thousands of times, only then did it finish dispersing, and the strips and lumps below the lower abdomen also dispersed.

Twenty-six: After the head and waist were both complete, one day while rubbing, the sinew of the little finger of the left hand contracted and stiffened; I knew it was the hand taiyang small intestine channel.
